conventions: The positive-only lint of voice descriptions (design section 3.5): a plain word list, whole-word and case-insensitive, that warns and never refuses.
Each finding gives the trigger word, its offset (code points into the description) and the phrase; suggestion is the table's rephrasing, or the default line when the table has no entry.

The phrase starts at the trigger and runs to the end of the hyphenated word the trigger is part of, otherwise through the next word, never across punctuation; a longer phrase from the suggestion table takes precedence (settled when the lint was built, WP10).
